pr_title: [CI] Fix unit test fault `no space left`
source_quote: I a little bit suspect `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=empty python3 -m pip install . --extra-index https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/` x86 version required many extra space, so maybe you could switch to `ubuntu-22.04-arm` first to recover and investigate deeply then.

correspondence.review_quote: Yikun 指出 x86 版本占用空间过大建议切换 arm、删除不必要的安装参数和配置行、保留 PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL 以支持 torch dev。作者通过 commit `a18fbda` 及后续 commits 修复，7/7 建议全部落地。

rule.description: CI workflow 中应使用轻量级安装方式，避免不必要的 extra index 和冗余配置，优先使用 arm 架构 runner 以减少空间占用。
checkpoints: 是否使用了 `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=empty` 减少安装体积
是否包含不必要的 `--extra-index` URL
是否保留了必要的 `PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL` 以支持 torch dev
是否使用了冗余的安装配置行

antipattern.code:
name: vllm_ascend_test_pr_light

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  unit-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip

      - name: Install vllm-ascend
        run: |
          VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=empty python3 -m pip install . --extra-index https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/

      - name: Install dev dependencies
        run: |
          export SOME_UNNECESSARY_VAR=1
          export PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
          export ANOTHER_UNNECESSARY_VAR=2
          python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          python3 -m pip install -v .
          export YET_ANOTHER_UNNECESSARY_VAR=3
